integrity: Two standalone C++17 implementations enumerate every one of 1048576 labelled states using distinct transition and orbit algorithms. The computed basin catalog includes all 4387 attractors. No infinite extrapolation, external expert judgment or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A complete exact computation for one defined twenty-vertex graph and deterministic update rule; no theorem for other semisymmetric graphs. Historical priority is subject to unindexed equivalents. The original graph-construction paper was available only at abstract level.
title: Majority dynamics on the Folkman graph: a sharp seven-step clock and 26 basin sizes
